extraction.notes: No qualifying finite summer youth camps were found on the official pages or in the supplemental official-site search. No 2027 camp information was found. The previously listed Summer Tennis consists of recurring drop-in instruction without a stated finite camp or clinic session; Summer Swim Lessons is explicitly a lesson offering. Both are excluded under the current camp rule.
